timeline: Long before Ibn Khordadbeh mapped Set Bandhai in 850, Rameshwaram's floating stones formed a natural limestone bridge.
Most people assume it is purely a mythological causeway built by floating rocks.
Others think it is just a modern coral reef formation.
But geologists found it is a series of sandstone and conglomerate ledges.
Formed naturally as sea levels shifted and fell over thousands of years.
A geological wonder linking two worlds across the Palk Strait.
